title: PSX Characters Sampler v1.20: 28 free characters, the track walker joins
bodyHtml:
New in 1.20.0: the track walker from Kombinat joins the free PSX Characters Sampler, which now has 28 characters, one from each of our 28 paid PSX packs. Kombinat is 14 adult workers of a Soviet factory, rail yard and metro, and the track walker is a man in a black cap, an orange signal vest over a dark grey quilted jacket and trousers, grey work gloves and black rubber boots.

Every character comes with the same model files its full pack ships: a GLB with all 45 animation clips and the reference T pose, a GLB per extra skin, FBX with clips, OBJ, 256 px textures and the Blender source. Across the 28 that is 85 skins. Each file is byte for byte the one in the paid pack. Eight Angles also ships every enemy as eight direction sprite sheets; the fire fiend's sheets are in the Eight Angles free demo file on the Eight Angles page.

We ran the tests again on the new download: a blank Godot 4.7.2 project imported every GLB, the PSX shader compiled on all 28 characters under Forward+, Compatibility and Mobile, and Blender imported every FBX (all 53 bones and every clip) and every OBJ back in. Unity and Unreal were not run here.

The full packs: Last Shift (13 characters, $9.99), Ironvale (14 characters, $7.99), Hollow Congregation (14 characters, $8.99), Fort Vale (14 characters, $9.99), Greyhollow (14 characters, $8.99), Deep Station (14 characters, $7.99), Pale Hours (14 characters, $7.99), Outpost (14 characters, $7.99), Grimsnout (14 characters, $7.99), Night Beat (14 characters, $7.99), Hollyfrost (14 characters, $7.99), Blackwater (14 characters, $7.99), Crosstown (14 characters, $6.99), Saint Oswin (14 characters, $7.99), Camp Redfern (14 characters, $7.99), Ashfall (14 characters, $7.99), Syndicate (14 characters, $7.99), Foxhole (14 characters, $7.99), Eight Angles (14 characters, $7.99), Oathfall (14 characters, $7.99), Plaguewick (14 characters, $7.99), Highcourt (14 characters, $7.99), Black Site (14 characters, $7.99), Butcher's Night (14 characters, $7.99), Showa Dusk (14 characters, $7.99), Courtyard (14 characters, $7.99), Cordon (14 characters, $7.99), Kombinat (14 characters, $7.99). Those are the list prices.

Every character was made with AI tools: bodies built by scripts an AI system wrote, textures painted by AI image models and projected onto the mesh.
